available_foundation.support: SurvivalState has a scalar shield amount and shield-before-HP absorption, but no shield identity/ownership/replace policy or resilience holder.

distinguishing_question: Does InitShield replace, accumulate, or associate a shield with this modifier instance, and what durable state is written by the no-argument SetResilience/DoReset pair?
why_not_executable: The source payload does not select an InitShield replace/accumulate/owner model; applying SurvivalState.apply_shield would silently choose accumulation.
SetResilience has no target or value in one callback and only DoReset=true in the other; the current BattleState has no resilience state holder or independently supported transition.
Executing only InitShield/RemoveShield would drop sibling state-affecting SetResilience operations, violating strict whole-entrypoint closure.
required_future_evidence: a version-aligned source or existing packet that defines shield instance ownership and stacking/replace semantics
a state holder and transition meaning for SetResilience/DoReset
the lifecycle/event boundary relating shield removal and modifier destruction
decision: Do not add a shield executor handler or promote MCommon_Protect_Shield. Preserve all four operations as BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET and move to a content-behavior mapping denominator task rather than inventing shield semantics.
